actions: Audited AgentA public promotion runner, holdout scorer, installer ACLs, and promotion archive path.
Separated hidden holdout sample secrecy from adaptive score-feedback secrecy.
Verified that current AgentA scaffold-edit/external-repo path skips benchmark and sealed holdout tiers.
Reviewed primary Falsifiable Release Gates paper for predeclared structural/invariant gate scope.
Reviewed current public Antahkarana v11 model-card claims for non-self-modifiable SelfImproveGate, eval freshness, external evidence, and held-out gain; retained implementation-verification boundary.
Checkpointed nonempty continuation frontier and advanced role-local LATEST pointer.
findings: A sealed evaluation file is not a sealed adaptive evaluation channel: AgentA hides holdout source/examples but persists exact holdout deltas into readable promotion/rejection metadata under its current public ACL/code design.

AgentA's self-modifying scaffold-edit candidate class skips the benchmark and sealed-holdout tiers in the current public runner path, so it does not satisfy the stronger exogenous behavioral promotion-gate frontier for scaffold self-modification.
Antahkarana's primary July release-gate paper provides strong structural/falsifiable warrant evidence but scopes its proof to bounded coordination rather than learned performance selection.

Current Antahkarana v11 public claims are near-frontier (strict verified gain, non-self-modifiable gate, eval freshness, external outcome evidence, lineage) but source/results needed to independently verify adaptive-reuse semantics are gated/uninspected in this run.
exact_next_action: Find an inspectable >10-proposal self-improving system where the self-modifying candidate class is actually subject to an exogenous incumbent-vs-candidate gate with bounded/reusable-holdout-safe feedback, then audit proposal chronology, eval freshness, score leakage, repeated-selection control, rollback lineage, and an untouched outer test. In parallel, look for inspectable Antahkarana v11 SelfImproveGate/INV-41 implementation or release artifacts before treating its public model-card claims as verified mechanism evidence.
